title: Introduce CI 'minimizer' mode and dep-curation dry-run report
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add a CI "minimizer" execution path that runs a targeted subset of lint/test jobs for small changes; add a dep-curation dry-run report job that surfaces transitive dep churn and pin recommendations; no user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: Feedback loop for engineers was stretched by running the full presubmit matrix on trivial repo edits and docs-only changes. We also lack an automated way to surface fragile transitive deps and suggest safe pins before they cause CI outages. What this PR does: 1) Adds a CI 'minimizer' mode: a lightweight presubmit path that selects a minimal set of linters and unit tests based on a change-impact classifier. The classifier is a fast heuristic that looks at file globs, language heuristics, and a small historical mapping; it runs as a step in the pipeline and emits an allowlist of jobs to run. 2) Adds a new GitHub Action job 'dep-curation-dryrun' that queries the dependency graph (yarn/go modules/pipenv), computes churn and semver-unsafe transitive edges, and uploads an HTML report to the CI artifacts bucket. The report includes recommended pins and a short risk score. 3) Bootstraps a small vendored shim and a caching layer for dependency metadata to avoid repeated network fetches in the presubmit path. 4) Adds an opt-in label 'ci:full' to force the full matrix when required. Checklist: - [x] Implement classifier and minimal job mapper - [x] Wire minimizer into existing presubmit workflows - [x] Implement dep-curation probe and report renderer - [x] Add caching for dep metadata and add lightweight vendor cache - [x] Add documentation in docs/ci/minimizer.md - [x] Update old CI entrypoints to call the new orchestrator - [x] Add smoke integration test for minimizer in perf-canary repo Follow-ups: 1) Replace heuristic classifier with a small ML model if false positives remain; tracked in ENG-4188, 2) Expand dep-curation to publish PR comments with actionable pins after security review (requires policy team sign-off).

CI summary: Initial CI run failed lint (2 failures), subsequent push fixed lint and all checks passed; dep-curation run uploads report artifacts successfully; smoke canary run passed in perf-canary against a small sample set.
Observability/telemetry additions: Add tracer spans around classifier decision and dep graph scanning
Security notes: dep-curation runs in restricted runner with least privilege; artifacts bucket access limited to CI service account; vendor shim executes only static analysis and does not run untrusted code.
Size and risk assessment: Additions ~732 lines, deletions ~219 lines, low-risk repo hygiene and CI ergonomics change; opt-out via label possible. No breaking changes to runtime or SDK.
Migration and rollout plan: 1) Enable minimizer on a subset of repos (redwood and redwood-examples) for 1 week, collect telemetry; 2) Expand to monorepo wide with opt-in to full matrix via label; 3) If false-positive rate > 8% revert to full matrix for affected directories.
Rollback plan: Revert presubmit workflow change and re-enable old workflow snapshots kept in .github/workflows/presubmit.legacy.yml.
Additional notes: Linear: ENG-4123 tracks rollout metrics; SUP-876 captured customer support note about noisy CI causing PR churn; CLI for report consumption is planned in follow-up.
